title: Import the Lakeside spring course catalog
text:
Matching only works if students can pick their real courses. Lakeside publishes the spring catalog as a PDF in late November, so Daniel will need to parse it (no API like Westbrook had).

*   Get the PDF from the registrar's site as soon as it's out
*   Daniel: write the import script for `pairly-api`, check course codes like "BIO 110" vs "BIO-110"
*   Spot-check 20 courses by hand before going live
